purpose: Source-backed current independent-link download and upload records, for candidate and published reference.

conditions.topology: Independent Link 46 QUIC and Link 47 TCP; each configured 200 Mbit/s.

clock.profile_origin: Runner bulk_loop_anchor monotonic event, the epoch/profile scheduler origin.
clock.probe_origin: probe.started; download has monotonic milliseconds, upload marker is Unix seconds joined through the paired runner event clock.
clock.alignment: Each series stores bulk_loop_anchor_from_probe_marker_s. qOS command bounds and UDP post-transition event points are relative to both profile and probe-marker clocks. Raw transfer bins and echo attempts retain probe clocks. No interpolation.
clock.upload_settlement: Upload includes all intervals through settlement; offered load lasts 40 s.

goodput.origin: Original probe interval order; download is the measured 40 s transfer and upload retains all delivery/settlement intervals.
